40000101.text: I came here several times with my father when I was little, but stopped eating here as often after growing up. I hope the food here will be to your tastes.

40000102.text: Oh, don't worry, we haven't eaten at a hotel like this in a while. Hehe, Paimon's getting excited already!

40000103.text: In that case, I'll go order for us first. Please wait here a moment.

40000104.text: Oho, everything looks so good! People in Fontaine sure know how to enjoy life.

40000105.text: Why, of course. Go ahead, try whatever you like. If the food's good, I'll make a group reservation for the rest of Spina di Rosula next time.

40000107.text: Well, ah... Then I'll still bring everyone, albeit with only one dish per table.

40000108.text: You uh, sure have your own way of doing things...

40000109.text: Oh, we called this a farewell meal, but we could also treat it like a victory feast, right? We did just win that case, after all.

40000112.text: Ooh, true, very true. In that case... Boss, we'll have another two dishes!

40000113.text: Huh! Paimon didn't mean that you had to order even more food!

40000115.text: Speaking of cases, do you think that the mastermind behind the serial disappearances will get caught soon now that this all has happened?

40000116.text: We've certainly taken a big step forward, but I feel that's about it. We know that there is an organization that means to dissolve these young women, but we still don't know what they are really after.

40000117.text: If it hadn't happened right in front of us, Paimon wouldn't have ever believed that a person could be dissolved like that...

40000118.text: Right? Yet it was because this was such a preposterous notion that the investigation could never really move forward before.

40000119.text: Ugh, if only that guy could've finished speaking... *sigh* We were so close to hearing who was behind it.

40000120.text: In such investigations, even the smallest step can seem like a yawning chasm if the trail of clues is cut off.

40000121.text: To be honest, I don't have high hopes for any follow-up that the authorities might conduct...

40000122.text: It's not that I don't have faith in their ability, it's just that a different perspective is required in some matters.

40000123.text: It's easy to guard against and deceive a single, narrow perspective. A shift in thinking is required at such times in order to produce a breakthrough.

40000124.text: Which is exactly why the Spina di Rosula exist.

40000125.text: Those highfalutin folk are not all-knowing. That's why we exist, to seep into the cracks where filth falls through, where their watch fails them. That's the kinds of problems we solve.

40000126.text: Huh. Seems Paimon thought things were simpler than they actually are...

40000127.text: *sigh* It's alright. Well, this was supposed to be a farewell meal, so I doubt you have further interest in this business, right?

40000128.text: Let's talk about something else. Like... what are your future plans?

40000801.text: Ooh, so... full... Paimon can barely float anymore...

40000803.text: Nah, that would be so... normal. Y'know, like you.

40000806.text: Hmm... Okay, as for expenses this month, we're left with...

40000807.text: Hey Navia, what are you doing over there?

40000808.text: Oh, nothing, nothing! It was just a meal, y'know. Nothin' the Spina di Rosula can't cover, haha... *sigh*

40000805.text: Can't you see Paimon's barely an inch off the ground?

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the fountain plaza in front of the opera house

40000201.text: There aren't many people around anymore. Looks like that boat we took to Erinnyes might have been the last one...

40000203.text: Huh, looks like we're back here again...

40000207.text: Uhhh... That's kinda spooky. Are you sure we don't wanna come back in the morning?

40000209.text: Hey! Why're you still walking towards it? There might be something nasty in the water...

40000304.text: Vacher? Are you... my dear Vacher?

40000305.text: No, wait, you seem to be someone else... Do you know Vacher? Do you know where my love is?

40000401.text: I should thank you for lending us your sword there, Clorinde. But before I do so, could you explain how you managed to show up here?

40000402.text: I... followed you. It seemed to me that danger has followed you more closely as of late.

40000403.text: I believe that following someone without their knowledge is actually called "stalking," is it not?

40000404.text: Mr. Callas' last wish was for me to ensure your safety, and I will not betray his trust. He would do the same, were he alive today.

40000405.text: Do not... speak of my father.

40000406.text: Sorry Demoiselle, I was not strong enough...

40000407.text: Thank you for your aid, Ms. Clorinde, but do keep an eye out for your manner of speech. I believe we all wish to avoid unnecessary emotional harm.

40000408.text: Sorry. I... did not consider your feelings.

40000409.text: Whatever. What else do you know? How did you come to the conclusion that I'd be in grave danger?

40000410.text: I doubt I know much more than you, but I believe that the mastermind behind the serial disappearances is very powerful.

40000411.text: Your performance tonight will almost certainly attract their attention.

40000412.text: Hehe, I'm sure they've known about me. To be honest, I'm shocked it's taken them this long to act against me.

40000413.text: And what about these Gardemeks? I thought only those associated with the Maison Gardiennage could control them.

40000414.text: None of these meka have serial numbers, I was sure to check a moment ago. They are not the ones used by the authorities to enforce the law.

40000415.text: I can only conclude that some powerful or wealthy party must have obtained them via illegal means, deploying them as a private force of sorts.

40000416.text: What, your point being that they're out of the Spina di Rosula's league then?

40000417.text: Yes. Be careful, and do not act rashly.

40000418.text: I will continue investigating no matter what. We will bring the truth to light. That's... my father's true last wish.

40000419.text: Regardless, thank you for your help today, Clorinde. But if you get any ideas, tell me first. I don't much appreciate being followed.

40000420.text: I do not think that they'll strike again any time soon, so I shall stop following you. Good day, all.

40000421.text: Right. I suppose that's the best news we've gotten today.

40000422.text: Demoiselle, I believe that Ms. Clorinde was being sincere with you. If we tried, we could attempt to thaw relations a little...

40000426.text: Thank goodness! Paimon thought we were done for!

40000427.text: Those Gardemeks came outta nowhere while you were unconscious, and Navia and her gang saved us.

40000428.text: Oh, and there was that Champion Duelist named Clorinde who came out to save us too. We got lucky there. Paimon probably couldn't have fought them off otherwise.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Spina di Rosula stronghold

40000501.text: It's right up ahead, but... Let's make sure we weren't followed first.

40000502.text: I've been keeping watch, Demoiselle. I haven't spotted anyone suspicious thus far.

40000503.text: Very good, but let's not let our guard down for now.

40000504.text: I shall find rooms for our respected guests.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the accommodations Navia arranged

40000701.text: So, uh, this is your base? It's not quite what Paimon imagined...

40000702.text: Your accommodations have been arranged. Under the present circumstances, I can confidently say it's the best we have.

40000705.text: Heh, well, our funds have been a little tight lately...

40000706.text: After all, we don't allow illegal or unethical profiteering. In fact, our funds often come from the citizenry who support us.

40000707.text: Seems like it's tough times for everyone... But if you have the support of the people, that does sound like it's worth it.

40000708.text: To be honest, our financial situation was a lot better back when my father was in charge a few years ago. I'm afraid I'm not quite his equal...

40000709.text: Your father... He was the previous boss of Spina di Rosula, right? How did he...

40000710.text: Demoiselle, if you'll allow me to explain...

40000711.text: No, I'll explain it myself. I suppose I couldn't run from this topic forever, and as partners, this is something I hope they can understand.

40000712.text: My father's name is Callas. Yes, the same one they call "Callas the Unfaithful" in the streets.

40000713.text: Three years ago, he was accused of murdering his own friend, but he chose a duel to defend his honor instead of standing trial. He died in the Duelists' Ring.

40000715.text: But I do not believe my father was a murderer. I'm sure he was set up...

40000716.text: At the time, I believed that if he only stood trial and was duly investigated, something amiss would crop up and prove his innocence.

40000717.text: But strangely, he not only requested the duel himself, but rumor has it...

40000718.text: ...That even after being seriously injured, to the point where he could be deemed as having lost the duel, he refused to surrender, determined to die in the arena.

40000719.text: Three years later, I still don't understand why he did that...

40000720.text: How could he protect his honor if he's dead? If anything he gave up his chance to defend himself.

40000901.text: A peaceful night passes under the Spina di Rosula's protection...

40000902.text: *yawn* Paimon slept so well! This place feels almost too safe...

40000903.text: Huh? Navia? Where did the other two go?

40000904.text: I sent them back to Poisson, it's Spina di Rosula's place of origin and where we have our headquarters. There's not much for them to do here at the moment.

40000905.text: Paimon gets the feeling that you're just trying to get them off your back...

40000906.text: But never mind that, when did you get back? Were you waiting here the whole time?

40000907.text: No, I just returned after going out for a while. I did some investigating yesterday regarding the name "Vacher."

40000908.text: Wait, so you didn't sleep at all!?

40000909.text: How could I after having such critical new evidence appear?

40000910.text: Uh, guess Paimon wasn't speaking for everyone just now, huh...

40000911.text: Unfortunately, this name seems to have been wiped from existence. It doesn't seem to have a match anywhere.

40000912.text: I suspect that those behind this have already taken steps to hinder an investigation from this angle — but that does prove that this Vacher person is a key witness in the incident.

40000913.text: Does that mean we're too late, though?

40000914.text: No, there is one ray of hope, one place in Fontaine that they would find almost impossible to threaten, no matter how much they wanted to.

40000915.text: And that is the archives kept by Chief Justice Neuvillette. A place where detailed files on all the cases in recent years are kept.

40000916.text: If the... Oceanid you met is one of the young women who went missing recently, we should be able to find some related information there.

40000917.text: So Neuvillette maintains an archive of case files? Guess that's the hardworking Chief Justice for you...

40000918.text: In that case, let's go talk to him, shall we?

40000920.text: Hmm? Aren't you coming along, Navia? Did you get tired?

40000921.text: *sigh* No, it's nothing. Let's go see the honorable Chief Justice.

40005101.text: Whether it be responsibility for Spina di Rosula or Master Callas' death, it all landed on Demoiselle's shoulders so suddenly...

40005102.text: This won't do. I must become stronger.
